lines.zh: 八条腿撑着这身甲，走得很稳
lines.en: Eight legs hold this shell steady as I walk.

lines.zh: 湿甲上滴着水，一路痕迹
lines.en: Water drips from my plating, leaving a trail.
My shell knocks stone with a muffled sound.

lines.zh: 陆地上我不习惯，但也走得到
lines.en: I'm not used to land, but I get there.

lines.zh: 每一步都像要把地压下去
lines.en: Each step seems to press the land down.

lines.zh: 海嗣的步法，你们学不来
lines.en: You can't learn how a seaborn walks.

lines.zh: 我朝着有活物的地方走
lines.en: I walk toward the living things.
Wet mud churns into a mess under me.

lines.zh: 走得不犹豫，也没有回头
lines.en: I don't hesitate, and I don't look back.
The walls near me all drip.
I'm listening; the land is too loud.
Something moves under my shell.

lines.zh: 我抬起身子，比树高半截
lines.en: I rear up, half a tree taller.
Water runs down off me.

lines.zh: 我不需要呼吸，只张合甲片
lines.en: I need no breath, only opening plates.
There isn't enough salt here.
I'm waiting for the sea to rise.

lines.zh: 我看见那边的光，不着急
lines.en: I see that light over there; no hurry.

lines.zh: 身上那些突起，会自己颤
lines.en: The spines on me quiver on their own.

lines.zh: 站着的时候，脚下的地更湿
lines.en: Standing here, the ground grows wetter.
I remember sounds from under the water.
This land will be sea in time.
Small things crawl between my plates.
I shake the water from my head.

lines.zh: 远处的村民在关门，我听着
lines.en: Villagers are shutting doors; I hear them.

lines.zh: 耐心是最不值得怀疑的东西
lines.en: Patience is the last thing to doubt.

lines.zh: 你在岸上走得太放松了
lines.en: You walk the shore too carelessly.
You stand too close; the foam is rising.

lines.zh: 把武器放低，那样死得慢些
lines.en: Lower your weapon; you'll die slower.
You carry no smell of the sea.
Step closer and you're within reach.
I've chased faster things than you.
You're counting my legs.
Your village doors are too thin.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸声，我听着难受
lines.en: Your breathing grates on me.

lines.zh: 我不说话，是因为没必要
lines.en: I don't speak because there's no need.
My being on this land is a mistake.
If you're going to run, do it now.

lines.zh: 甲碎了一块，水从缝里流
lines.en: A plate shattered and water runs through the gap.
I gave half a block, my legs still holding.
That isn't pain, only an inconvenience.
The shell regrows; don't celebrate.
My blood runs cold.
It cracked a plate.
The wet ground dips where I stepped.
Press once more and you can't hold.

lines.zh: 这具身体在提醒我，该进食了
lines.en: This body reminds me it's time to feed.
You've seen me bleed; step back.
Food? Only living things are fresh.
That meat in your hand is too small.
I don't eat anything cooked.
Your companions are more meat than that.
Put it down, then back away.
Salt, I smell it.
This much would only let me taste.
Living smells better than dead.

lines.zh: 你拿这个来换命，不够重
lines.en: This isn't heavy enough for your life.

lines.zh: 我收下了，不代表我不吃你
lines.en: I'll take it, which doesn't mean I won't eat you.

lines.zh: 撞上我，你会被推开很远
lines.en: Hit me and you'll be shoved far.
My shell is harder than your bones.
Don't lean on wet plating.
That'll leave your shoulder aching.
Eight legs planted; you can't push me.
You stepped on one of my legs.
My plates clamped on you.
Back off, the water follows me.

lines.zh: 你身上沾了海嗣的黏液
lines.en: You're covered in seaborn slime.

lines.zh: 碰一下，就够你回去洗三天
lines.en: One touch and you'll scrub for three days.
That isn't how we multiply.

lines.zh: 海嗣靠的是吞食与进化
lines.en: Seaborn grow by feeding and evolving.

lines.zh: 这身甲，是自己长出来的
lines.en: This shell grew from within.
My kind only compete for food when they meet.

lines.zh: 我不需要伴，只需要更多的海
lines.en: I need no partner, only more sea.
You ask because you're afraid.
There's nothing on land to match me.

lines.zh: 甲片一片片剥下来，才是后代
lines.en: My offspring are shed plates.
Don't stand so close to listen.

lines.zh: 深海里，我们的关系只有吃
lines.en: In the deep, our only relation is eating.
I curl this up off the ground.
I only touch wet things.
This weighs like a stone.
My tendrils work better than hands.
I pick it up and sniff first.
It's stuck to my shell.

lines.zh: 给活着的东西留着，我不需要
lines.en: Leave it for the living; I don't need it.
What's on the ground rots eventually.
This isn't fresh.
I keep it; it may be of use.
The iron golem, take that one first.
Villagers behind a door; I hear them.

lines.zh: 那个亮着的东西，先打碎
lines.en: That glowing thing, break it first.
The living things in the distance are running.
Once I fix on one, I don't switch.
Range is good; fire one now.
Its pace is slow; I can wait.

lines.zh: 从侧面过去，别让它看见
lines.en: Approach from the flank; don't let it see.
This body needs to feed.
That thing is trembling.

lines.zh: 水里是我的地盘，陆上不是
lines.en: Water is my ground; land is not.
Someone's on the roof; hit him first.
I've seen its position.
One gust and I'll be there.
One target only; don't get distracted.
I've reared up; now I can reach.
It's backed into the corner.
At this moment, I'm ready.
It's running faster than before.
Break its armor first.
I draw force from the water for this.
Get to the wall behind it.
Its companions are calling; useless.
The distance is shrinking; don't rush.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，从低处过去
lines.en: I lower myself and come in low.
It raised a hand; I take half a step back.
This ground is too dry; I'm uncomfortable.
A little closer and I'll crush it.
I'm counting how many steps it ran.
It's hiding behind a house.
I've soaked a stretch of wall.
That path will give way; I know it.
It threw something; I don't dodge.
Close enough to smell it.
I open my plates, ready.
It has nowhere left to retreat.
One more breath and I lunge.
Now, all my weight.
My plates close and clamp it.
A tendril whips out and binds a leg.

lines.zh: 这一撞，它整个退进墙里
lines.en: This charge drives it into the wall.

lines.zh: 身上的水泼出去，溅了一脸
lines.en: I fling water off me into its face.
I press down and the ground gives.

lines.zh: 它挡了甲片，没挡住腕足
lines.en: It blocked the plates, not the tendrils.
I drop from above and pin you down.
It's thrown and rolls twice.
This one carries seaborn venom.
It stopped moving; I finish it.
A tendril whips and flips it over.

lines.zh: 甲边划过，留下一道口子
lines.en: My shell's edge passes and opens a gash.

lines.zh: 整具身体压下去，它喘不上气
lines.en: My whole weight settles and it can't breathe.
It retreats, and I press one block forward.
Water seeps up through the ground first.
I push up out of the wet mud.

lines.zh: 甲片还带着深海的颜色
lines.en: My plates still hold the deep sea's color.

lines.zh: 这片陆地上多了一个不该有的东西
lines.en: Something that shouldn't be here is on this land.

lines.zh: 海嗣又往前推进了一格
lines.en: The seaborn have advanced one more block.

lines.zh: 我落地时，附近的井水浑了
lines.en: When I landed, the nearby well water clouded.

lines.zh: 刷怪蛋打开的那一刻，盐味先到
lines.en: The moment the egg opens, the salt smell arrives.
I look up; the sky is too high.
The tide hasn't come; I've come first.
The ground is damp here, which suits me.
I rise, my shell still dripping.

lines.zh: 这道防线上，又开了一个口
lines.en: Another breach opens in the line.

lines.zh: 从深海里爬上来，很费力
lines.en: Climbing out of the deep was hard.

lines.zh: 这一刻，村里的人该醒了
lines.en: At this moment, the village should wake.

lines.zh: 我闻到了铁和木头的味道
lines.en: I smell iron and wood.

lines.zh: 我不属于这里，但我会留下
lines.en: I don't belong here, but I'll stay.
I turn to look toward the sea.

lines.zh: 身上的水在地上积成一小滩
lines.en: Water pools in a small puddle beneath me.
The things in my seams woke too.
This land will be flooded in the end.

lines.zh: 火烤着我的甲，甲里更湿
lines.en: Fire bakes my shell, and it's wetter inside.
I fell, and my shell struck first.

lines.zh: 水底是我的地方，我往下沉
lines.en: The bottom is my place; I sink.
The blast flipped my plates open.
The arrow lodged in a seam.
Magic can't get through my shell.
Hunger thins my shell.

lines.zh: 雷打在湿甲上，通体一麻
lines.en: Lightning hits wet plating and numbs me all over.
The void is deeper than the deep sea.
